name: FairJackpot

methods.name: create
methods.desc:
Deploy FairJackpot. first_close_ts is the unix timestamp of the first
draw boundary (production: next 20:00 UTC; test instances may use minutes).

methods.name: accrue
methods.desc:
Record a settled wager. Called as an INNER app call from a registered game's
resolve() (Txn.sender == the game's application address), immediately after the game's inner payment of jackpot_cut to this contract.
NO paused check: a paused pot must never revert the calling game's resolve(). Pause gates draws, not accrual.

events.name: AccrueSkipped
events.desc: Ticket issuance skipped (MBR float exhausted). The jackpot cut is still kept.

methods.name: deposit_pot
methods.desc:
Credit a direct contribution to the drawable pot: backstop top-ups, the
v1 seed migration, public donations. Anyone can feed the pot.

methods.name: commit_draw
methods.desc:
Close the current epoch and commit the draw to a future VRF round.
Permissionless and time-gated; the epoch advances HERE (not at resolve) so bets settling during the commit->resolve window accrue into the new epoch.

events.name: DrawSkipped
events.desc: Zero-ticket epoch closed without a draw; the pot rolls over untouched.

methods.name: resolve_draw
methods.desc:
Resolve the pending draw. Permissionless: hints are untrusted entry indexes
(one per slot) that the contract verifies against the VRF-derived ticket numbers; a wrong hint reverts. Winners are paid by inner transactions; the remainder (>= 10% by construction, plus dust and excluded slots) rolls over.

events.name: DrawResolved
events.desc:
Complete draw record -- the keeper reconstructs the DB row from this event
    alone after a crash, so it must carry everything (winners in slot order, an
    excluded slot keeps its address with payout 0 for transparency).

methods.name: recommit_draw
methods.desc:
Re-target an expired pending draw to a fresh VRF round. The beacon retains
~70 min of outputs; a draw not resolved in that window is otherwise stuck forever. Permissionless, but only after the original round is provably beyond rescue-by-keeper (RECOMMIT_AFTER_ROUNDS) -- a live draw cannot be re-rolled by racing the resolver.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.desc:
Delete ticket boxes of a fully resolved epoch, reclaiming MBR into the
operational float. Permissionless: only epochs that can never be read by a draw again are deletable. Missing boxes are skipped (no revert on races).

methods.name: noop
methods.desc: Box-reference/budget carrier for group composition. Does nothing.

methods.name: set_params
methods.desc: Update the payout split for FUTURE commits. Admin only.

methods.name: set_game
methods.desc:
Register/replace an authorized game by app id in slot 1-4 (0 clears).
Admin only. Stores the game's application ADDRESS (accrue caller check).

methods.name: set_excluded
methods.desc: Set/clear a ticket-excluded house wallet in slot 1-8. Admin only.

methods.name: set_paused
methods.desc: Pause draws (commit/resolve). Does NOT gate accrue() or deposits. Admin only.

methods.name: set_admin
methods.desc: Transfer admin rights. Current admin only.

methods.name: set_beacon_app_id
methods.desc:
Override the beacon app id. Admin only AND only while paused with no
pending draw -- the beacon cannot be swapped under a committed draw.

methods.name: get_player_tickets
methods.desc: Tickets issued to a player in an epoch (0 if no settled bets).
